ms.report:
Addressing Approver Feedback - 29th Nov

1) Please clarify, in the workshop agenda, if Winter protocol implementation demo will be for the Cardano blockchain, as in the pre-workshop reading material there is no single mention about Cardano. Also, I am unsure how you will address the VC and SSI as, again, there is no mention about these terms in the forementioned material. 
The Winter Protocol is compatible for both the Ergo and Cardano blockchain. However, the key component that we are building out are the VC and SSI capabilities that will leverage Atala Prism on the Cardano side. 
The new submission for the workshop agenda and pre-workshop materials will now reflect this. We have also created a new document which is a deep-dive into VC and SSI tools - in this document we have highlighted Atala Prism as the potential solution. This is under 3 links in Evidence 1.
However, it is important to outline that the core purpose of building this technology is to make the solution simple such that the users don’t need to know about what the underlying blockchain is. We will leverage Atala Prism for the key SSI and VC components - we have found that talking about the concepts is a much more productive use of time with stakeholders as opposed to getting into the details of which blockchain. 
We will make sure we find the right balance - I should have clarified this earlier. Thank you for pointing it out. The changes will be addressed in the workshop materials. 

2). Regarding the video interview I would expect to keep the same format for all 4 stakeholders. 2 videos have images for the participants, one is not similar, as there are just voices, and the there is no video interview evidence for Natalie Simwami Stamos. I tend to accept the video with no images but is difficult to accept as evidence a screenshot of a WhatsApp phone call. If you have any explanations, please make it available in the Discussion module of this page.

ms.promise:
・Conduct on-ground workshops: Organize workshops in Zambia, bringing together small-holder producers, stakeholders, and experts to understand the specific challenges and needs in the commodity sector. These sessions will leverage findings from Milestone 1 and the expert interviews to understand how to effectively deploy and pilot the commodity certification system.

・MVP Pilot Launch is LIVE: Deploy a pilot of the verifiable credentials and oracles module with small-holder honey farmers in Zambia. The goal of the pilot will be to onboard an established honey factory, their small-holder farmers they source from, conduct farmer-level organic surveys and record this on-chain.

・As part of MVP Pilot, a key output is conducing testing of the design with producers: Conduct on-the-ground testing of the new design with a selected group of producers to gather feedback and insights.
